posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
I've (finally) added deck boxes to the VotM collection on my site, both unsleeved and penny-sleeved.

Now that there are so many multi-villain villains, some with the same name as their non-multi-villain selves, I decided there should be a way to distinguish which are for the multi-villain format and which aren't just by looking at the boxes.  To that end, I put a white box around the "V" and the word "Villain" on the multi-villain boxes, making them easy to tell apart.  I likewise went back and added the same marking to the Vengeance villains so all multi-villain deck boxes now have the same identifier.  If you're so inclined, you can go back and reprint the V5 decks, but of course you don't have to.

The full set of VotM accessories isn't complete yet, unfortunately.  I still need to make the small hp trackers and the Advanced cards for the VotM villains.

posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
VotM accessories are now complete on my site.

GtG has come through with the remainder of the Oblivaeon art (thanks, guys!) so I was able to finish off my set of accessories.  I have just updated the files on my site to include:
